app.name: Multi-Agent Workbench
login.hint: The user name and password are in config/server.toml in the workbench folder.
scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.stop_confirm: Stopping the scheduler ends the stages that are running; they are requeued at the next start. Stop it?
scheduler.queued_hint: Requirements are queued. They move only while the scheduler is running.
board.empty: No requirements yet. Select New requirement to start.
new.title: New requirement
new.name: Title
new.text_hint: What happens, what is expected, and when it counts as done. Markdown is fine.
new.no_project: Register a project in lane.toml on the Configuration page first
lane.archived: This requirement is archived and can only be viewed.
lane.gate_spec: The spec is drafted. Read the spec below, then approve it or reject it with notes.
lane.gate_merge: The summary is ready. Read the summary below, then confirm it or send it back with notes. The workbench does not merge the branch for you.
lane.reject_hint: Notes are required; the agent revises according to them
lane.clean_confirm: Remove the worktree of {id} and archive it? The branch is kept.
lane.discard_confirm: {id} is not finished. Discarding removes the worktree and archives it; the branch is kept. Continue?
lane.running_hint: Running. To stop it, stop the scheduler on the board.
stats.thin: There are only a few requirements so far, so these numbers mean little yet.
config.intro: Edit the configuration files directly. lane.toml is checked before saving and is not saved if it is malformed or missing required parts. Changes apply at once; the scheduler rereads the file on every pass.
config.discard_confirm: This file has unsaved changes. Discard them?
config.new_rules_prompt: Project name (the same as [projects.xxx] in lane.toml; letters, digits, - and _ only)
config.from_template: Filled from the rules template. Edit, then save
config.server_note: The sign-in user name and password are in config/server.toml. For safety they cannot be viewed or changed here.
